title: City charm victorian, trendy WeHo 1 mi to dwntwn!
description:
Come share my home with me! LaLaLand is a beautiful owner-occupied Victorian home located just 1 mile south of the heart of downtown in the trendy art district of the Chestnut Hill/Wedgewood-Houston neighborhood. My home is walking distance to Soho House, Geodis Park, coffee shops, restaurants, bakeries, breweries and downtown Nashville. Guests enjoy 2 private bedroom suites (queen beds) & private full bath, plus share the kitchen, family room, laundry room and backyard space with live-in host.

The space
WELCOME

Welcome to LaLaLand — a charming Victorian retreat in Nashville’s vibrant Wedgewood-Houston arts district, just one mile from downtown.
 I'm LaLa. I'm a singer-songwriter and your owner-occupied AirBnb host. 

My beautiful victorian home is located in the middle of Music City in the trendy arts district of the Chestnut Hill/Wedgewood Houston neighborhood,  just 1 mile south of the heart of downtown Nashville and the Broadway Honky Tonks, and only a couple miles from 12 South District, Historic Belmont/Hillsboro, trendy East Nashville, Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, Ascend Amphitheater, Vanderbilt and Belmont Universities and much more! I am walking distance to downtown, Soho House, Geodis Park Soccer Stadium, the Nashville flea market, a monthly art crawl and myriad cafes, coffee shops, restaurants, bars, distilleries and parks. It's also less than a mile in either direction to every major interstate for easy access to everything that you can't walk, Lyft or Uber to.

NO PARTYING OR PARTIES: This house is in a residential area. If you're looking for a property to host a loud or rowdy group, this is not the right fit. Disturbing guests will be asked to leave and/or fined. 

NOTE: I am a working musician, so you may find yourself listening in on a rehearsal, a co-write or a songwriters' jam session. If this would be an issue for you, please let me know in advance and I can schedule these happenings elsewhere.

ROOM RATES: The rates include city taxes.

ABOUT MY HOME: Built in 1899, my house has been updated with the latest amenities but still has its historic charm with high ceilings and the original hardwood floors throughout. Guests will enjoy a full coffee bar with microwave in a custom-built penny wall alcove space in the hallway, both of which have a chalkboard wall that I encourage my guests to write on and leave a message! I have a beautiful, comfy and spacious living room that I share with my guests with the most comfortable 3-way sectional couch for lounging around, a smart tv and surround sound system, perfect for watching movies or your favorite shows. Guests can enjoy my extensive library of books in both the hallway and one of the bedrooms. My beautiful kitchen, as well as a laundry room, are available for use upon request. I love my space and feel it has a magical, joyous energy that I love to share with others who walk through my door! 

BEDROOMS: Your beautiful bedroom is furnished with a comfy queen bed with lush memory foam and gel pillows, luxury linens, ceiling fan, mounted TV, ROKU streaming and apps, a window with custom shades, dresser drawers, mirrors and hanging closet space. One of the bedrooms, as well as the hallway, contains a library for those of you who love to read!

BATHROOM: As my guests, you will enjoy a large bathroom with a tub/shower combo, luxury fluffy bath towels, and basic toiletries, including shampoo & conditioner, body lotion, blow dryer and curling/straightening irons. There is also plenty of counter space and drawer space for all of your toiletries.

SHARED SPACES: The kitchen, family room and laundry are shared spaces with me, the owner. As my guests, you are welcome to use these spaces as needed, but please clear it with me first if you would like to use the kitchen stove top and/or laundry facilities.

ACCESSING THE HOUSE: You will receive instructions regarding accessing the house once you have booked your stay at LaLaLand.

OTHER AMENITIES OF NOTE: Complimentary WiFi, printer/scanner & ROKU tv.

CLEANING FEE: There is a $75 cleaning fee that will be included when you book the reservation.

FREE PARKING: Parking is typically plentiful in the parking lanes on either side of the street directly in front of my house, which is a one way street heading into downtown, but there are certain hours during the weekdays that parking is prohibited on one side of the street while school is in session.

Guest access
Guests will have access to their reserved private bedrooms and private bathroom, kitchen, family room, and common living areas.

***PLEASE NOTE*** LaLaLand is owner-occupied, so you may see me occasionally in shared spaces, but I respect guest privacy completely.

Laundry access may be available upon request.

During your stay
I live in the home and am available if needed, but I respect your privacy and interaction level preferences completely.

Many guests enjoy the peaceful, welcoming atmosphere LaLaLand offers.
